prompt: Spring SimpleJdbcCall stored function metadata lookup supported databases
answer:
For current Spring Framework 7, `SimpleJdbcCall` supports stored-function metadata lookup for:

- MariaDB
- Microsoft SQL Server
- MySQL
- Oracle
- PostgreSQL

For other databases, declare all parameters explicitly. [[SimpleJdbcCall Javadoc](https://docs.spring.io/spring-framework/docs/current/javadoc-api/org/springframework/jdbc/core/simple/SimpleJdbcCall.html), [CallMetaDataProviderFactory](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/blob/master/spring-jdbc/src/main/java/org/springframework/jdbc/core/metadata/CallMetaDataProviderFactory.java)]

An older Spring Framework reference page lists only MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and Oracle; the current API source additionally includes MariaDB and PostgreSQL.
